items.title: COMMITMENT
items.quote: I lift my soul to You, Hashem.
items.text: Commit yourself totally to the service of your Creator by concentrating all of your mental and emotional resources on the words of your tefillos to Him.

items.w: אלהי בך בטחתי אל אבושה אל יעלצו איבי לי
items.title: BEING SHAMED
items.quote: My G-d, in You I have trusted. Let me not be shamed. Let my enemies not gloat over me.
items.text: Ask Hashem to keep you from being shamed before those who wish to harm you because your enemies are His enemies and your defeat will be a reflection on the One in Whom you have trusted.

items.title: FUTURE DELIVERANCE
items.quote: Let all those who look with hope to You also not be shamed.
items.text: Ask Hashem not to limit His deliverance to you, but to grant it to all who have bitachon in Him throughout the coming years.

items.title: TORAH
items.quote: Make Your ways known to me, Hashem. Teach me Your paths.
items.text: Ask Hashem to help you learn and understand the Torah.

items.title: EARLY SINS
items.quote: Don’t recall the sins and offenses of my youth.
items.text: Ask Hashem to treat your early sins as though they never happened, for you were carried away by the foolishness of youth.

items.w: טוב וישר יהוה על כן יורה חטאים בדרך
items.title: GOOD AND UPRIGHT
items.quote: Hashem is good and upright. Therefore He guides sinners on the way.
items.text: You can trust Hashem to do what is right and to do what is best for you, because He cares for your well-being and gives you the help you need, if you ask for it.

items.w: ידרך ענוים במשפט וילמד ענוים דרכו
items.title: COMMITMENT
items.quote: He guides the humble in justice and He teaches His way to the humble.

items.w: ידרך ענוים במשפט וילמד ענוים דרכו
items.title: HUMILITY
items.quote: He guides the humble in justice and He teaches His way to the humble.
items.text: By practising humility you will become worthy of acquiring the wisdom of the Torah. The best example for this is Moshe Rabbeinu, who excelled in humility and in knowledge of the Torah, which he taught to his nation.

items.w: למען שמך יהוה וסלחת לעוני כי רב הוא
items.title: RECENT SINS
items.quote: Hashem, because of Your Name, absolve me of my serious transgression even though it is great.
items.text: Confess the seriousness of your sins and ask Hashem to forgive you. If your sincere He will surely do so because of His Name (“good and upright.)” Bear in mind that your sins are painful to Hashem. Therefore if you feel anguish about the effect upon Him of the greatness of your sins, that would be a reason for Him to absolve you of them.

items.w: נפשו בטוב תלין וזרעו יירש ארץ
items.title: GOOD CHILDREN
items.quote: His soul will abide in goodness and his offspring will inherit the land.
items.text: There is a connection between the goodness with which you conduct your home and the effect upon your children, so that they will follow the way of Hashem and become worthy of inheriting the land of life.

items.title: THE MYSTERY
items.quote: The mystery of Hashem is for those who fear Him. And He makes known His covenant to them.
items.text: Hashem’s Torah has infinite depths, which are revealed to those who are worthy.

items.w: פנה אלי וחנני כי יחיד ועני אני
items.title: PITY
items.quote: Turn to me and have pity on me for I am alone and impoverished.
items.text: Plead with Hashem to grant you His favor because you have no one to help you out of your present difficulties. Even if you feel that you have been challenged with a unique trouble and that nobody is suffering as you are, don’t be discouraged but turn to Hashem.

items.w: פדה אלהים את ישראל מכל צרותיו
items.title: REDEMPTION
items.quote: O G-d, redeem Yisrael from all its troubles.
items.text: Even if you are not worthy, plead with Hashem to save your nation.
